hookLine: Sports brands love calling every single ad inspiring. Let's see who actually earned that word.

items.voiceLine: Inarritu directs a global chain reaction. Ronaldinho literally turns into a demon on the pitch. This isn't an ad, it's a short film. S-Tier, no contest!
Kaepernick risks his career for one line. Believe in something, even if it means sacrificing everything. Nike did not play it safe. S-Tier, and they knew exactly what they were doing!

Adidas crams football, basketball, running AND skating into one ad and calls it a strategy. That's not focus, that's picking every option on the menu because you couldn't decide! Forgettable the second it ends. C-Tier, no offense... okay, some offense.

Puma's 'Forever Faster' is just gorgeous slow-motion footage of people moving... slowly. The name and the ad are literally fighting each other! Beautiful cinematography, zero punch. B-Tier, all style, barely any story.

outroLine: Four ads, zero apologies. Which one hit hardest? Drop it below, and hit subscribe!
